summary: Iteration 102 - Verified variant-aware component consumption feature (Fix 2 backend). All 4 new tests passed + 15 regression tests from iteration 99 passed.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_VAR_102_ prefixed items during tests, all cleaned up after each test class
context_for_next_testing_agent: Variant-aware component consumption feature verified working. The _resolve_variant_child_item helper correctly redirects consumption to variant child SKUs when MO has variant_selection matching a BOM component's variant_attributes.

backend.details: Created CP-VAR with Grit=16GT,30GT variants, generated children with 100 stock each. Created MO with variant_selection={Grit:30GT}. After WO /start: CP-VAR-30GT stock dropped from 100 to 95 (consumed 5), CP-VAR parent stock unchanged at 0, CP-VAR-16GT stock unchanged at 100, RM-PLAIN stock dropped from 100 to 90 (consumed 10).

Created CP-VAR with variants, deleted CP-VAR-30GT, set parent stock to 100. Created MO with variant_selection={Grit:30GT}. After WO /start: CP-VAR parent stock dropped from 100 to 95 (graceful fallback works), no error thrown.

Created FG with inherited variants from component. Created MO with variant_selection={Grade:A}. Verified variant_sku set correctly. WO completion credits FG variant child SKU (regression test - already passing).

Created component with variants (parent stock 100, variant children stock 50 each). Created MO WITHOUT variant_selection. After WO /start: Component parent stock dropped from 100 to 95, variant children stock unchanged at 50 each (legacy behavior preserved).

regression.details: All 15 variant inheritance tests passed - no regression

features_verified.variant_aware_consumption: WO /start with MO that has variant_selection consumes from variant child of variant-bearing BOM components (e.g., CRW0E8000091-30GT instead of CRW0E8000091)
features_verified.graceful_fallback: When variant child doesn't exist, consumption falls back to parent item without error
features_verified.fg_variant_credit: WO completion credits FG stock to FG variant child SKU (regression - still working)
features_verified.legacy_behavior: MO without variant_selection consumes from parent items (unchanged)
